class_rule_source.rule: POND_CLASSES=(2,3,5,6,7), cell plane finite iff any corner class is in set and level>0.80m; <=0.80m is excluded from pond pieces/assigned to engine sea per build_water_pieces source text. The class NPZ is a source-metadata diagnostic, not a byte-proven derivation input of deployed PBO.

water_support_mask.scope: Narva sector only; it is a protection/contact mask and explicitly excludes P9 reconstruction and does not declare runtime water.

civil_inventory.coverage_policy: union of every face-bearing P3D LOD for every matching WRP object; no LOD labeled as exact collision/physical semantics
limitations: offline projected model-face union; not an in-game collision readback
union conservatively freezes cell intersections from visual, roadway, shadow, or other face-bearing LODs
X/Z projection discards Y and can overprotect bridge-deck and support-beam footprints

interpretation_limits: P remains NaN/unknown; metadata class and engine sea fallback do not replace P or prove runtime surface/depth.
A zero compiled-face area is a geometric coverage result only inside these corridor∩unknown-P patches.
Bridge P3D bounds are all face-bearing LOD vertex AABBs; disjointness excludes these nine objects, not arbitrary runtime water suppression.
Civil bridge cells are sector-scoped; for Luga the full transformed bridge AABBs, not the cell list, establish separation.
The 18,024 indexed water objects are the exact name-selected water set; the nine civil bridge WRP records are separate object classes, not a missing water-object count.
